series.name: eqFinancials
series.description: Quarterly revenue, net income and free cash flow of a large-cap stock

series.name: eqEps
series.description: Quarterly EPS: consensus estimate before the report and the surprise of the reported figure (fraction of the estimate)

series.name: eqValuation
series.description: Trailing twelve-month earnings per share (price / this = trailing P/E)

series.name: eqTargets
series.description: Analyst 12-month price targets: high, mean and low

series.name: eqSegments
series.description: Quarterly revenue by business segment

series.name: eqMargins
series.description: Quarterly gross, operating and net margin

series.name: eqRevisions
series.description: Consensus next-fiscal-year EPS and the number of analyst estimate raises and cuts per week
series.unit: USD per share; count per week

series.name: eqDividend
series.description: Quarterly dividend per share and its earnings coverage (EPS / dividend)

series.name: eqShortInterest
series.description: Short interest as a fraction of free float and the annualised stock borrow fee

series.name: eqGuidance
series.description: Quarterly revenue guidance (midpoint and half-width as a fraction) and the reported revenue

series.name: eqBuyback
series.description: Quarterly share repurchases and shares outstanding

series.name: eqQuality
series.description: Quarterly net income, operating cash flow and total assets

series.name: eqBreadth
series.description: Net advancing issues (advancers minus decliners) of a broad stock market, per day

series.name: cnAuction
series.description: Opening call auction feed: indicative match price change vs previous close, matched volume and unmatched imbalance (buy positive)

series.name: cnMoneyFlow
series.description: Daily net inflow by order size: extra-large, large, medium and small orders

series.name: cnConnect
series.description: Daily net buying of A-shares through the cross-border stock connect

series.name: cnLimits
series.description: Market-wide limit-up and limit-down counts and the failed limit-up rate (touched the limit but closed below it)

series.name: cnSentiment
series.description: Market breadth inputs: advancing stocks (of about 5,300), limit-up count and the highest consecutive limit-up streak

series.name: cnMargin
series.description: Market-wide margin financing balance and securities lending balance

series.name: cnConvertible
series.description: A convertible bond's conversion premium (over conversion value) and bond-floor premium (over its straight-bond value)

series.name: cnWarrants
series.description: Registered warehouse receipts of a futures contract

series.name: fundCefPrice
series.description: A listed fund: net asset value per share and the premium (+) or discount (-) of its market price to NAV, as a fraction

series.name: fundTracker
series.description: An index (the symbol's price) and the NAV of a fund tracking it at about 1/10 of the index

series.name: fundGrowthNav
series.description: Net asset value per share of an actively managed growth fund

series.name: fundHoldings
series.description: Quarterly portfolio weights of a fund's five largest holdings

series.name: fundUnits
series.description: Fund shares outstanding (rise on subscriptions, fall on redemptions)

series.name: fundTotalReturn
series.description: Total-return index of the symbol: price plus reinvested dividends, about 100 today

events.name: eqDividends
events.description: Quarterly cash dividend ex-dates, amount per share

events.name: eqBuybackAnnouncements
events.description: Share repurchase authorisations, amount in USD

events.name: eqSplits
events.description: Stock splits (value: new shares per old share)

events.name: eqInsider
events.description: Insider open-market trades, signed value in USD (buy positive)

events.name: eqEarnings
events.description: Earnings reports on the days of large moves; value is the EPS surprise as a fraction

events.name: cnBlockTrades
events.description: Block trades: premium (positive) or discount to the day's close as a fraction; label is the buying branch

events.name: cnUnlocks
events.description: Lock-up expiries of restricted shares, market value unlocked in CNY

events.name: cnIpos
events.description: New listings: first-day return as a fraction of the offer price

events.name: fundManagerChanges
events.description: Days a fund's portfolio manager changed
